name: Immovable Bolthead
description: Stand square at the stock with the weight on the heels and the eye level, the school's first posture.

name: Magnanimous Aimframe
description: Wind the string with the breath in two halves, one for each arm, until both sit at the catch together.

name: Peal Springarm
description: Carry the eye from the near pin to the far pin to the mark in one smooth glance.

name: Splendid Impalement
description: Throw the bolt level across the basin rim, the arm release crisp and the stock unmoving.

name: Vigor Windlassdrum
description: Reseat the bolt and string within a breath of the last release, with qi at the winch hand.

name: Soundless Skewerbolt
description: Spin on the ball of the foot behind the stock to follow a mark crossing the engine's front.

name: Thunderclap Stakedrive
description: Charge both arms with qi along the school's pattern and release one bolt of long, flat flight.

name: Unwavering Bowarms
description: Hold the wound engine at ready beneath a mantlet while the crew rotates, the arms locked in place by qi.

name: Steelslider
description: Aim from the basin rim down onto the floor, packing qi into the heavy bolt so that it punches through cover.

name: Quenched Boltflight
description: The school's own culminating bolt, gathered through a full wind of qi and loosed in the Azure pattern to pierce the line.

name: Eclipse Aimframe
description: Call the aimer and loader posts of the pair in set words so that neither crew mistakes its duty.

name: Skyborne Impalement
description: Walk the engine forward with two crews stepping on the same beat, wheel for wheel.

name: Vigor Stockbed
description: Stock one rack between the paired engines so that either crew can draw from the same shafts.

name: Stakecrown
description: Loose one engine, wind it, and let the other take over, keeping a bolt in the air at every beat.

name: Noble Bolthead
description: Bring both stocks onto one mark from slightly different angles and loose on a shared call.

name: Millstone Sinewcord
description: Fire at the approaches of a gate in paired bursts so that no force can rush it.

name: Dust Skewerbolt
description: Pass a tired pair back and a fresh pair forward in a single drilled movement.

name: Pulsar Boltflight
description: Cross the bolts of the two engines through one target so that no shield can cover both lines.

name: Immaculate Trackbed
description: Hold the pair steady against a charge, mantlets overlapping, with qi keeping the winding steady.

name: Pulsarstreak
description: Gather both engines through a matched breath, then release together so both bolts strike a single point.

name: Pulsar Stakedrive
description: The garrison school's paired culminating shot, the two engines loosed on one gathered count into the same mark.

name: Enshrined Springarm
description: Crouch low behind the great engine's stock, chin on the rail, as a hawk sits over prey.

name: Bolthead Largesse
description: Mark the horizon line on the sight so that the elevation is always read from the same level.

name: Lifegiving Sinewcord
description: Drop a hawk's down feather from the hand and watch its drift to read the air.

name: Vigor Aimframe
description: Strike the great string's loop onto the catch with the heel of the hand until it seats with a clean click.

name: Radiance Windlassdrum
description: Release low and long so that the heavy bolt glides over the field as a hawk glides on still air.

name: Serene Springarm
description: Hold the sight above the mark by the soaring lift of the bolt and drop it as the bolt peaks.

name: Sovereign Stakedrive
description: Choose the officer by his plumes and loose a heavy bolt through the gap between his guards.

name: Hurtleboon
description: Turn the great engine on its carriage to answer a new threat while the string stays wound.

name: Prismstake
description: Drive the great bolt's barbed head through a shield wall so that it hooks and drags a shield away.

name: Thunderclap Boltflight
description: Hold the great engine at full wind with qi drawn into the eyes, then loose the instant the mark enters the sight.

name: Prism Impalement
description: Lift the great stock to its highest angle and release so the bolt drops through a roof of shields.

name: Famed Thunderclap Trackbed
description: The school's own culminating throw, sighted by the eye of the hawk and loosed with the whole great engine's strength.

name: Custody Stockbed
description: Lay flat river stones under each wheel so that the carriage rests level on soft ground.

name: Tranquil Trackbed
description: Rest the eye on running water beside the mark to steady it, then sight across.

name: Compassionate Bowarms
description: Carry spare bolts in a reed rope sling across the shoulder, hands free for the winch.

name: Skewerbolt Crown
description: Loose a long throw across the river from bank to bank at a landing party's boats.

name: Peal Bowarms
description: Lead a drifting raft by the speed of the current and loose so the bolt meets it.

name: Exalted Impalement
description: Aim just above the waterline of a barge so that the bolt strikes the strakes and floods the hold.

name: Clawbanner
description: Lob a heavy bolt over a bank of raised shields onto the boats behind it.

name: Masterful Trackbed
description: Fire bolts in lines across a narrow channel until the water is choked with wreck and no boat passes.

name: Sliderverdict
description: Gather qi to the arms while the current runs, then loose one bolt that tears through the strakes of a laden barge.

name: Streakdecree
description: The school's own bolt, loosed from the river bank after a long gather so that it opens a hull from end to end.

name: Immovable Springarm
description: Brace the whole body behind the siege engine's twin rails, the feet set to take the heaviest recoil.

name: Luminous Bolthead
description: Let the qi field reach out to the winch and turn it, sparing the body's own strength.

name: Peal Sinewcord
description: Sight along both rails to the mark and confirm that the tracks are true.

name: Hurtletriumph
description: Loose the heaviest siege shaft flat along the rails at the shield line.

name: Volition Windlassdrum
description: Run the slider back along both rails and seat the next bolt in a single field-aided motion.

name: Deluge Boltflight
description: Slide the engine a carriage-width along its rails to avoid a return bolt.

name: Pulsarslider
description: Aim the siege bolt at a gate's centre and send it through with the field's weight behind it.

name: Custody Aimframe
description: Hold the shield frame against the engine's front while winding, keeping the crew covered.

name: Triumphant Stockbed
description: Gather qi into the rails through a long hold, then release a bolt that drives through two ranks and a screen.

name: Imperial Steel Bowarms
description: The school's own bolt, loosed after the field has filled both rails, driving the siege shaft through the strongest line.

name: Stockbed Troth
description: Stand with the Core settled low and still, the whole body a post that the engine rests upon.

name: Clement Bolthead
description: Let the Core's warmth rise into the hands as the winch turns, easing the heaviest draw.

name: Reminiscence Bowarms
description: Read the sky above the mark for the clarity of the air, and judge the clean flight ahead.

name: Storied Stakedrive
description: Drive qi from the Core through the arms at release, so the bolt leaves with a deep note.

name: Illustrious Skewerbolt
description: Raise the stock to the far angle and loose with Core qi in the legs for a long, steady lift.

name: Sacrosanct Trackbed
description: Take the engine's recoil into the Core and the planted feet so that the carriage barely shifts.

name: Revelation Windlassdrum
description: Fix the eyes on one mark through a long wait, Core qi steadying the whole frame.

name: Magnificent Impalement
description: Drive a Core-charged bolt through a line of locked shields as though they were screens of reed.

name: Thunderclap Skewerbolt
description: Hold the engine at full wind while the Core's qi fills both arms, then release in one slow breath.

name: Pulsarhurtle
description: Fill the wound arms from the Core until the frame sings, then loose one bolt that breaks a gate beam.

name: Paramount Stockbed Verdict
description: The school's highest bolt, loosed from the Core after a full gather, with engine, crew and breath as one.

name: Custody Springarm
description: Stand with the feet apart and the knees soft, taking the engine's weight as a sworn watch.

name: Vigor Sinewcord
description: Wind the string to a count of oath words, each word a pull, until the catch seats.

name: Bountiful Aimframe
description: Look from landmark to mark in one glance to fix the bearing the oath will hold.

name: Peal Boltflight
description: Level the stock on the open plateau and loose a bolt that flies flat and true.

name: Stakedecree
description: Loose in the instant between two gusts, the hands already set by long practice.

name: Clawsolace
description: Step the engine round a quarter turn to keep the wind at its back.

name: Streaktriumph
description: Charge the arms with qi in the wind-sworn manner and loose a bolt that holds its line.

name: Revered Aimframe
description: Hold the engine's bearing through a rising gale, the crew's voices keeping time to the oath.

name: Vacuum Stakedrive
description: Time the release to the gale's strongest push and loose a bolt that carries through a pair of shields.

name: Matchless Sinewcord Banner
description: The school's own bolt, loosed after the crew has sworn aloud and held the bearing through the wind.

name: Interstice Stockbed
description: Each member states his post aloud as an oath before the engine is wound.

name: Bedrock Sinewcord
description: Pile flat stones in a low windbreak at the engine's side to shelter the winders.

name: Reminiscence Bolthead
description: Call the bearing to the aimer by hand signs that the wind cannot carry away.

name: Delugestake
description: Haul the engine across the plateau by rope teams that pull on a sung count.

name: Millstone Springarm
description: Loose steadily along the crew's line of oath, never letting an enemy step across it.

name: Deluge Stakedrive
description: Move the crew in a staggered line to the windward side to loose with the wind's help.

name: Heroic Skewerbolt
description: Cross the bolts of two engines on the same sworn mark from different bearings.

name: Dauntless Boltflight
description: Loose a whistling bolt across the plateau to warn a patrol and halt a probing column.

name: Sliderbanner
description: Loose all the engines of a crew in an agreed order, each shot on the oath's cadence.

name: Custody Bowarms
description: Hold the whole crew's line against a rush, the wind-oath said aloud while the engines load.

name: Clawcrown
description: Gather the whole crew at full wind through a long oath, then loose together so the bolts break a rush.

name: Fearless Thunderclap Windlassdrum
description: The crew school's own culminating volley, loosed on the final oath word so that the bolts fall as one.

name: Devout Windlassdrum
description: Brace both feet against the deck seams and lean with the swell, never against it.

name: Eclipse Trackbed
description: Sight along a pin fixed to the rail to hold a bearing across the pitching water.

name: Vigor Bolthead
description: Time each pull of the winch to the swell so that the string comes home in the trough.

name: Hurtlebanner
description: Loose from behind a curtain of spray so that the enemy cannot mark the engine.

name: Streakgrace
description: Slide the stock along the deck rail to take up a new bearing on a turning ship.

name: Lordly Impalement
description: Lead a fast ship by the length of her wake and loose so that the bolt meets her at the beam.

name: Royal Bowarms
description: Hold the bearing on a rolling ship through three swells and loose at the best moment.

name: Vacuumstake
description: Drive a heavy bolt through the strakes of an enemy hull at the point where she rolls toward the engine.

name: Hurtlecrown
description: Hold the bearing on an enemy mast, gather qi through the long swell, then loose one bolt to split it.

name: Vaunted Quenched Claw
description: The school's own bolt, loosed from the deck after a long held bearing so that it strikes where the hull is weakest.

name: Steel Stockbed
description: Stand the engine a long stride from the edge with the wheels chocked and the hands free.

name: Revelation Sinewcord
description: Read the valley's wind from the smoke of distant fires and the bend of the trees below.

name: Reminiscence Trackbed
description: Pace out known marks on the slope below and cut their distances into the stock.

name: Streakedict
description: Aim down the slope face and loose a bolt that gains speed as it falls onto the path.

name: Nurturing Claw
description: Reset the anchor rope after the recoil so the engine is held as before for the next shot.

name: Seasonclaw
description: Rake the switchbacks of a mountain road with bolts in rhythm, so no column can climb in file.

name: Slidercrown
description: Cut the rope that holds a pile of loose rock above a road with a single sharp-headed bolt.

name: Hurtleverdict
description: Take a climber's rope at the lip and let the weight of the fall do the work.

name: Millstone Aimframe
description: Loose a long line of bolts down the slope in measured steps, so the path is sealed.

name: Steel Boltflight
description: Hold at the edge of the drop while qi gathers, then loose one great bolt that crashes through a rank below.

name: Radiance Stakedrive
description: The school's own bolt, loosed from the edge on a sworn bearing so that it falls where the path is narrowest.

name: Statute Springarm
description: Brace the body against the gale's push, the legs rooted and the hands light on the stock.

name: Gracious Windlassdrum
description: Spread the qi field a little beyond the body and read the wind by its touch on the field.

name: Wise Bowarms
description: Sight along the long bolt's shaft to confirm that it has not warped in the damp.

name: Slidertriumph
description: Loose the long bolt into the gale with its nose set a hair upwind.

name: Stockbed Benison
description: Adjust the aim by the qi field's reading of the wind as the string reaches the catch.

name: Stakeverdict
description: Seize the lull in a storm of gusts and loose before it passes.

name: Clawdecree
description: Drive the long bolt through a gale with the field's strength behind it, to strike a far shield.

name: Peal Skewerbolt
description: Steady the whole frame by oath and field, and loose at a mark at the engine's furthest reach.

name: Unrivaled Hurtle
description: Gather qi through a long still oath, then loose a bolt that rides the gale to its mark.

name: Streakverdict
description: The school's own long throw, loosed on the lull after a sworn gather so that it holds its bearing to the end.

name: Prism Sinewcord
description: Settle the Core low and let the stance carry the weight of the engine without strain.

name: Benevolent Claw
description: Wind the string in time with the Core's slow breath, each pull on the exhale.

name: Hospitable Aimframe
description: Read the plateau's far horizon for dust and cloud, and judge the weather's turn.

name: Merciful Bolthead
description: Touch the oath stone at the carriage's foot before the first draw to fix the oath in mind.

name: Intrepid Impalement
description: Charge the arms from the Core with the wind's push and release one deep-flying bolt.

name: Reminiscence Springarm
description: Hold the bearing through a long wait with the Core calming every tremor of the hand.

name: Bedrock Streak
description: Loose a rolling volley with the winding fed from the Core, never pausing for rest.

name: Slidergrace
description: Turn the engine against a shift of wind to take up the new bearing in a breath.

name: Gallant Skewerbolt
description: Drive a Core-charged bolt into a gale so that it passes through the wind and a shield alike.

name: Vacuum Slider
description: Overdraw the arms with the Core's strength, taking the bolt past its usual flight.

name: Streakcrown
description: Gather the Core and the oath through a long hold, then loose one great bolt along the bearing.

name: Staketriumph
description: The school's highest bolt, loosed from the Core after the whole crew has sworn and the wind has been held.
